_about: One row per decision a humanoid enemy makes. chance values are design choices scaled by the NPC's Skyrim combat skill (0-100): chance = base + per_skill * skill, clamped 0..1. uses: row id in moves.json or 'swings' for any swings row. reaction_ms: delay before the NPC can respond, so parries stay beatable.

rows.note: random strike direction; stab more often at range

rows.when: incoming attack enters release, facing it
rows.note: falls to base when out of stamina or in recovery

rows.when: in windup, target is holding parry
rows.note: only with stamina above feint cost

rows.when: incoming strike in chamber window, skill > 60
a MORDHAU bot becomes the stand-in of a Skyrim character
rows.note: MORDHAU hands bots a behaviour profile of its own choosing (seen: BOTBEHAVIOR_Worthless2 - no well-timed parries, up to 0.4 s of timing error; seen in play as poor parrying). The stand-in's profile is overwritten: PerfectParryProbability = base (0.55), ParryTimingVariance 0..0.08 s, ParryTimingRandom 0.04, FallForFeintProbability 0.5, FootworkInsteadOfParryProbability 0.05, RiposteProbability 1, FeintProbability 0.2, MorphProbability 0.15, ChamberProbability 0.3. One level for everyone for now (not yet by the Skyrim character's level). 2026-10-08 02:20: the profile alone did nothing - the bot (profile Worthless2) stood idle or played its yield emote at the player's releases, never a parry. So the script itself asks for the parry: as the player's swing is released within 230 cm of an idle stand-in, it parries with the chance `base` (0.55), and its emotes are cut short.

rows.when: F8 in game (weapon out or away): a list to pick from; remembered between sessions
rows.note: five levels for every stand-in - 1 Peasant: parries 15% of the player's swings, well-timed parry 0.10, feints 0.00, morphs 0.00, hesitates 0.9 s before attacking; 2 Recruit: 35%, 0.30, 0.05, 0.00, 0.6 s; 3 Soldier (default): 55%, 0.55, 0.20, 0.15, 0.4 s; 4 Veteran: 75%, 0.75, 0.35, 0.30, 0.25 s; 5 Duelist: 90%, 0.90, 0.50, 0.45, 0.1 s. Sent as ' ai:<level>'.

boss_skill._about: Named (unique) enemies and ones well above the player's level fight above the skill level chosen in the F8 menu (never above 5).
